caption: Figure 1. The trade-off between Pixel 1 latency and top-1 ImageNet accuracy. All models use the input resolution 224. description:
This figure is a line graph showing the trade-off between Pixel 1 latency and top-1 ImageNet accuracy for various mobile models. The left panel displays small mobile models with 20-40ms CPU latency, while the right panel shows large mobile models with 40-100ms CPU latency. The MobileNetV3 small model has the highest accuracy at 70%, while the MobileNetV2 model has the lowest accuracy at 56%. The MobileNetV3 large model has the highest latency at 110ms, while the MobileNetV2 model has the lowest latency at 15ms.
